page.overview:
What is Nikyu Nikyu no Mi?

The Nikyu Nikyu no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that grants the ability to repel anything via paws permanently manifested on the user's palms, making the user a . It was a treasure of the World Nobles before it was stolen and eaten by Bartholomew Kuma.

This fruit's abilities were duplicated in the Seraphim S-Bear, via a transfusion of Green Blood.

The Nikyu Nikyu no Mi is a round fruit with flesh-pink rind that features the typical swirl pattern, as well as three rounded lumps on top that overall make the fruit resemble a three-digit paw, and emerging from the middle lump is the fruit's T-shaped stem with the right end curled.

As explained by Kuma, this Devil Fruit bestows via invulnerable five-digit on the user's palms; since these paws are permanently manifested, the current ability user, Kuma, always wears gloves when not using his power. Anything that touches or is touched by the paws can be pushed away at will with variable (usually immense) speed and force, with this repellent effect requiring no actual pushing motion on the user's part. The paws are only present on the palms and not the feet.
